source: AssetTools manifests/authored.db: TransGame.Default__TnProfileSettings.PresetIconicCharacters (authored order = the iconic wheel's order). Each preset's data (CharacterName, Specialty, ChassisTypes, weapons, abilities) comes from manifests/mp_content/mp_characters.json characters[].iconic_preset.
note: The three car soldiers (Decepticon / Autobot / Neutral) are in the authored list but are never referenced by an MP map (AssetTools mp_status); the frontend leaves them out of the playable set. LockedCharacter presets follow the same unlock check as locked chassis (TnCharacterScriptBinding IsChassisUnlocked).
